description: This Java source file defines the PolicySupervisorActor class, an Akka actor responsible for supervising PolicyPersistenceActor instances. It manages creation, supervision, and restart logic using exponential backoff strategies. The class includes methods for constructing actor properties, handling entity ID extraction, and configuring supervision behavior, with references to policy-related configurations and exceptions.

classes.name: PolicySupervisorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class supervising PolicyPersistenceActor instances, providing restart and supervision strategies for policy persistence.

methods.description: Constructs the Props object for creating the internal PolicyPersistenceActor, passing necessary configurations.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the exponential back-off configuration for restarting the child actor based on policies configuration.
